originalVerifyYaml:
verify:
    name: Verify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          # Preservation tests compare current records with pinned release baselines.
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install Chromium for browser-backed tests
        run: npx playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Type-check
        run: npm run type-check

      - name: Verify calculation formulas and jurisdictional data
        run: npm run calculation-quality:check

      - name: Verify static data fallback freshness
        run: npm run data:fallbacks:check

      - name: AI contract tests
        run: npm run test:ai

      - name: Unit and integration tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Verify multipart parser boundaries
        run: node --test tests/multipart-parser-boundary.test.js

      - name: Verify forex context expiry at runtime
        run: node tests/ai-forex-runtime-expiry.test.js && node tests/ai-tool-context-invariants.test.js && node tests/ai-consent-server.test.js

      - name: Verify private command-centre contracts
        run: node --test tests/operator-dashboard-auth.test.mjs tests/operator-engine.test.mjs

      - name: Verify Pro architecture
        run: npm run pro:verify

      - name: Validate i18n dictionaries
        run: npm run build:i18n:validate

      - name: Validate hreflang graph
        run: npm run validate:hreflang
